cmd = """python3 -c "
import urllib.request, json, re

# Fetch Moon wikitext
url_moon = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon'
req = urllib.request.urlopen(url_moon)
data_moon = json.loads(req.read().decode('utf-8'))
pages_moon = data_moon['query']['pages']
wikitext_moon = list(pages_moon.values())[0]['revisions'][0]['*']

perigee_matches = re.findall(r'.{0,100}perigee.{0,100}', wikitext_moon, re.IGNORECASE)
print('Moon perigee matches:')
for m in perigee_matches:
    print(' -', m.strip())

# Fetch Kipchoge wikitext
url_kip = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Eliud_Kipchoge'
req_kip = urllib.request.urlopen(url_kip)
data_kip = json.loads(req_kip.read().decode('utf-8'))
pages_kip = list(data_kip['query']['pages'].values())[0]
wikitext_kip = pages_kip['revisions'][0]['*']

wr_matches = re.findall(r'.{0,100}marathon.{0,100}', wikitext_kip, re.IGNORECASE)
print('\\nKipchoge matches preview:')
for m in wr_matches[:10]:
    print(' -', m.strip())
"
"""
out = await run_command(cmd)
print(out)
```
